visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium close-up of a woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing gold earrings and a striped top, walking through a brightly lit indoor mall corridor. A young boy in a red shirt walks beside her, smiling broadly at the camera. (2) The camera cuts to the storefront of a retail shop named 'Claire's,' which features purple signage and displays of various hair accessories and plush toys. A man in a blue patterned short-sleeved shirt is seen walking toward the entrance of the store. (3) Inside the store, the woman speaks directly to the camera in a close-up, occasionally touching her left earlobe while standing in front of a white wall. The boy in the red shirt is seated in a specialized purple piercing chair, looking calm and expectant. (4) A technician with curly dark hair and white gloves is shown using a black pen to mark the boy's earlobe, followed by cleaning the area with a small white wipe. Other children, including a young girl with pigtails, are visible in the background watching with curious expressions. (5) A close-up shows the technician holding a white piercing tool against the boy's ear. The boy flinches slightly but keeps his eyes closed. Immediately after, he opens his eyes and smiles at the camera, revealing a small gold stud in his ear. (6) A second, younger boy is then seen seated in the same purple chair. The technician repeats the preparation process, and a quick shot shows the piercing tool being triggered. (7) The video concludes with a group shot of the woman and the two boys, both of whom are showing off their new earrings and smiling brightly, standing against a backdrop of store merchandise.
